questions.text: Describe a small business in your area that you like.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a small business in your area that you like. You should say: what kind of business it is; where it is; what it sells or does; and explain why you like this business.

questions.text: Do you know the people who run this business?
questions.say: Thank you. Do you know the people who run this business?

questions.text: Why do some people prefer to shop at small local businesses?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a small business in your area that you like, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all small businesses. Why do some people prefer to shop at small local businesses?

questions.text: What problems do small businesses face today?
